implemented_work.summary: Added createConfiguredPlanningAnswer so the configured provider can generate structured JSON planning suggestions. Provider policy checks remain centralized and remote-provider restrictions are preserved.

Kept generatePreviewSuggestions deterministic and synchronous for backward compatibility. Added generateConfiguredPreviewSuggestions with deterministic/provider/hybrid modes, provider JSON parsing, output normalization, approval-required suggestions, and deterministic fallback.
Updated POST /suggestions to use generateConfiguredPreviewSuggestions with default hybrid mode and optional provider override.

Preserved runPlanningSession as synchronous deterministic behavior for existing route/test compatibility. Added runConfiguredPlanningSession as an async provider-aware planning runner for future route/UI wiring.
Added regression tests proving provider-backed suggestions and fallback behavior.
